name: codex-frontend-plugin
description: Anti-cheat visual frontend feedback loop for Codex-built UIs.

interface.shortDescription: Build real UIs from mockups with anti-cheat visual feedback.
interface.longDescription: Adds a frontend mockup skill and local visual-check tooling so Codex must pass anti-cheat, asset, DOM, interaction, responsive, and accessibility validation before comparing a generated UI screenshot against a reference mockup.
defaultPrompt: Use the frontend-mockup skill to implement this mockup as a real semantic UI, then run npm run visual:check and iterate on the visual report.
Capture and compare the current frontend against .visual-references/home.png.
Explain the anti-cheat visual report and propose the smallest UI changes to pass every gate.
